name: Anamika Barua
interests: Climate Change and Water security, Ecological Footprint, Virtual Water flows through trade, Water governance including transboundary water governance
bio: Dr. Anamika Barua is a Professor at the Dept. of Humanities and Social Sciences, Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IITG), India. Trained in Ecological Economics, her research interest lies in understanding how political, social and economic factors shapes environmental decisions and change, particularly related to water. She has published peer-reviewed articles in several leading international journals, and have recently edited a book on ‘Climate Change Governance and Adaptation’ published by CRC press.
